citation: Whittaker, J. V., Kinzie, M. B., Vitiello, V. E., DeCoster, J., Mulcahy, C., & Barton, E. A. (2020). Impacts of an early childhood mathematics and science intervention on teaching practices and child outcomes. Journal of Research on Educational Effectiveness, 13(2), 177-212. https://doi.org/10.1080/19345747.2019.1710884
report_number: ERIC ED661533 (Grantee Submission, IES Grants R305A120631 & R305B140026); journal article JREE 13(2):177-212
design: Cluster-RCT (stratified random assignment at the teacher/classroom level); MyTeachingPartner-Math/Science (MTP-M/S) curricula + coaching/PD vs business-as-usual (BaU) control; 140 pre-K classrooms (Year 1: 70 treatment / 70 control); ~1,266-1,371 children assessed across two consecutive single-year cohorts; pre-K; math & science. Year 1 = experimental; Year 2 = quasi-experimental (55.8% classroom attrition, baseline non-equivalence on NSPV & MTP-STEAM). Models run at the classroom level (child data aggregated to classroom), FIML, controlling for fall child outcomes + child/teacher demographics + program type + site.
problems: Legal OA copy is the IES Grantee Submission accepted manuscript on ERIC (ED661533); the published JREE version is paywalled but the grantee manuscript reports the full impact tables (Tables 8-9) and is funder-deposited and legal. Two single-year cohorts (one per study year) rather than a single longitudinal sample, so Year 1 and Year 2 spring measurements are END-OF-TREATMENT waves for DISTINCT samples (both extracted; not double-counted across the same children). Year 2 results carry an authors-noted internal-validity caveat (high attrition -> quasi-experimental; NSPV & MTP-STEAM baseline d > .30, fail WWC equivalence). Table 9 g column is reported to only 2 decimals and is a rounded derivation of the standardized beta; impact_estimate = standardized beta, impact_se = SE{beta} (both exact from Table 9); g_se/g_var are approximate, scaled from SE{beta} by the reported g/beta ratio (ratio noisy for small betas due to rounding). Per-condition, per-year child n's are not separately tabulated; analysis unit is the classroom, so n_t/n_c and n_clusters are the classroom counts. ICC not reported and not applicable for correction here because the impact model is estimated at the classroom (cluster) level (data aggregated within cluster), so clustering is inherently accounted for. ALL achievement outcomes are math/science -> STEM; the project FIXTURE rows labeling this study 'Reading' are synthetic placeholders, not real data.

effect_sizes.test_name: MTP-STEAM (Short Tools for Early Assessment in Mathematics; adapted short form of TEAM, + measurement/shapes items)
effect_sizes.g_method: Reported in Table 9 (g = -0.06): classroom-level standardized regression coefficient (Mplus FIML) for treatment, controlling for fall MTP-STEAM + covariates, standardized to control-group fall SD. impact_estimate = standardized beta (-0.034), impact_se = SE{beta} (0.061). g_se approximated as SE{beta} x (g/beta).
effect_sizes.notes: Direct child math assessment. Year 1 = experimental wave (meets WWC; 10.3% overall / 2.3% differential attrition at fall, 19.2%/4.6% at spring). Non-significant (p=.57). Classroom-level means in Table 2 are aggregated within classroom.

effect_sizes.test_name: NSPV (Number Sense and Place Value dynamic assessment; Kinzie et al. 2014)
effect_sizes.g_method: Reported in Table 9 (g = 0.14): classroom-level standardized regression coefficient (Mplus FIML), controlling for fall NSPV + covariates, standardized to control-group fall SD. impact_estimate = beta (0.085), impact_se = SE{beta} (0.066). g_se approximated as SE{beta} x (g/beta).
effect_sizes.notes: Direct child math assessment. Year 1 experimental wave. Non-significant (p=.20).

effect_sizes.test_name: LENS on Science (adaptive IRT science assessment; Greenfield et al. 2011)
effect_sizes.g_method: Reported in Table 9 (g = 0.10): classroom-level standardized regression coefficient (Mplus FIML), controlling for fall LENS + covariates, standardized to control-group fall SD. impact_estimate = beta (0.053), impact_se = SE{beta} (0.051). g_se approximated as SE{beta} x (g/beta).
effect_sizes.notes: Direct child science assessment; published independent IRT-based instrument (closest to standardized/independent of the measures here). Year 1 experimental wave. Non-significant (p=.30).

effect_sizes.test_name: PAS (Preschool Assessment of Science, task-based; Gropen et al. 2017)
effect_sizes.g_method: Reported in Table 9 (g = -0.06): classroom-level standardized treatment coefficient (Mplus FIML), covariate-adjusted. PAS has no fall score, so the coefficient compares spring means (posttest-only, covariate-adjusted) rather than residualized change. impact_estimate = beta (-0.030), impact_se = SE{beta} (0.069). g_se approximated as SE{beta} x (g/beta).
effect_sizes.notes: Direct child science assessment, independent instrument. Spring-only (no fall baseline), so covariate-adjusted posttest contrast, not residualized change. Year 1 experimental wave. Non-significant (p=.66).

effect_sizes.test_name: ARS Math (Academic Rating Scale, teacher-rated; adapted from ECLS-K + 5 items)
effect_sizes.g_method: Reported in Table 9 (g = -0.09): classroom-level standardized regression coefficient (Mplus FIML), controlling for fall ARS-Math + covariates, standardized to control-group fall SD. impact_estimate = beta (-0.063), impact_se = SE{beta} (0.072). g_se approximated as SE{beta} x (g/beta).
effect_sizes.notes: Teacher-rating measure of math skills (not a direct child assessment; rater = treatment-aware teacher). Year 1 experimental wave. Non-significant (p=.39).

effect_sizes.test_name: ARS Science (Academic Rating Scale, teacher-rated; adapted from ECLS-K + 7 items)
effect_sizes.g_method: Reported in Table 9 (g = 0.03): classroom-level standardized regression coefficient (Mplus FIML), controlling for fall ARS-Science + covariates, standardized to control-group fall SD. impact_estimate = beta (0.019), impact_se = SE{beta} (0.069). g_se approximated as SE{beta} x (g/beta).
effect_sizes.notes: Teacher-rating measure of science skills. Year 1 experimental wave. Non-significant (p=.78).

effect_sizes.test_name: MTP-STEAM (Short Tools for Early Assessment in Mathematics)
effect_sizes.g_method: Reported in Table 9 (g = 0.06): classroom-level standardized regression coefficient (Mplus FIML), controlling for fall MTP-STEAM + covariates, standardized to control-group fall SD. impact_estimate = beta (0.041), impact_se = SE{beta} (0.072). g_se approximated as SE{beta} x (g/beta).
effect_sizes.notes: Year 2 = quasi-experimental (55.8% classroom attrition). MTP-STEAM had baseline non-equivalence at spring Year 2 (d = -0.41, fails WWC), so this contrast is internal-validity-compromised. Non-significant (p=.57). Separate cohort from Year 1 (consecutive single-year cohorts).

effect_sizes.test_name: NSPV (Number Sense and Place Value dynamic assessment)
effect_sizes.g_method: Reported in Table 9 (g = 0.17): classroom-level standardized regression coefficient (Mplus FIML), controlling for fall NSPV + covariates, standardized to control-group fall SD. impact_estimate = beta (0.112), impact_se = SE{beta} (0.088). g_se approximated as SE{beta} x (g/beta).
effect_sizes.notes: Year 2 quasi-experimental. NSPV had baseline non-equivalence at spring Year 2 (d = -0.39, fails WWC). Non-significant (p=.21). Separate cohort from Year 1.

effect_sizes.test_name: LENS on Science (adaptive IRT science assessment)
effect_sizes.g_method: Reported in Table 9 (g = 0.20): classroom-level standardized regression coefficient (Mplus FIML), controlling for fall LENS + covariates, standardized to control-group fall SD. impact_estimate = beta (0.100), impact_se = SE{beta} (0.069). g_se approximated as SE{beta} x (g/beta).
effect_sizes.notes: Direct child science assessment, independent IRT instrument. Year 2 quasi-experimental. LENS met baseline equivalence (d = -0.09). Non-significant (p=.15).

effect_sizes.g_method: Reported in Table 9 (g = 0.39): classroom-level standardized treatment coefficient (Mplus FIML), covariate-adjusted; PAS has no fall score so it is a covariate-adjusted posttest-only contrast. impact_estimate = beta (0.220), impact_se = SE{beta} (0.088). g_se approximated as SE{beta} x (g/beta).
effect_sizes.notes: Direct child science assessment, independent instrument. Year 2 quasi-experimental. STATISTICALLY SIGNIFICANT favoring treatment (p=.01); one of the paper's three significant Year 2 child effects. Spring-only (no fall baseline) -> covariate-adjusted posttest contrast.

effect_sizes.g_method: Reported in Table 9 (g = 0.26): classroom-level standardized regression coefficient (Mplus FIML), controlling for fall ARS-Math + covariates, standardized to control-group fall SD. impact_estimate = beta (0.238), impact_se = SE{beta} (0.087). g_se approximated as SE{beta} x (g/beta).
effect_sizes.notes: Teacher-rating measure (treatment-aware rater). Year 2 quasi-experimental. STATISTICALLY SIGNIFICANT favoring treatment (p=.006). ARS-Math met baseline equivalence (d = -0.01).

effect_sizes.g_method: Reported in Table 9 (g = 0.25): classroom-level standardized regression coefficient (Mplus FIML), controlling for fall ARS-Science + covariates, standardized to control-group fall SD. impact_estimate = beta (0.212), impact_se = SE{beta} (0.087). g_se approximated as SE{beta} x (g/beta).
effect_sizes.notes: Teacher-rating measure (treatment-aware rater). Year 2 quasi-experimental. STATISTICALLY SIGNIFICANT favoring treatment (p=.01). ARS-Science met baseline equivalence (d = -0.12).
